title: COSI: A Framework for Robustly Valid Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.22096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce COSI (COnfidence from Scale Invariance), a framework for constructing confidence sets for statistical functionals. COSI builds on the HulC (Hull-based Confidence), which uses median unbiasedness to construct confidence sets from batch estimates. COSI uses scale-invariance properties shared by many common estimators. We divide the data into batches, compute an estimate in each batch, and retain each candidate parameter value for which the batch estimates pass a test of scale invariance. The resulting confidence sets are asymptotically valid under weaker assumptions than classical Wald and bootstrap procedures require, and their coverage can be closer to the nominal level in small samples. Applications include robust inference for the mean, regression coefficients in misspecified linear models, tensor norms, and Fr\'echet means.

translated_title: COSI：一个稳健有效推断的框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了COSI（基于尺度不变性的置信方法，COnfidence from Scale Invariance），这是一个用于构建统计泛函置信集的框架。COSI建立在HulC（基于包络的置信方法，Hull-based Confidence）之上，后者利用中位数无偏性从分批估计中构建置信集。COSI利用了许多常见估计量所共有的尺度不变性。我们将数据划分为若干批次，在每个批次中计算估计值，并保留那些批次估计通过尺度不变性检验的候选参数值。所得的置信集在比经典Wald方法和bootstrap方法更弱的假设下具有渐近有效性，且在小样本情况下其覆盖率可以更接近名义水平。应用包括对均值的稳健推断、误设线性模型中的回归系数、张量范数以及Fréchet均值的推断。
tldr: COSI框架利用估计量的尺度不变性，通过分批估计构建置信集，在较弱的假设下即可实现渐近有效推断，且小样本覆盖率更接近名义水平。
en_tdlr: COSI leverages scale-invariance properties of common estimators to construct confidence sets that are asymptotically valid under weaker assumptions than Wald and bootstrap methods, with coverage closer to nominal levels in small samples.
